diagnosis: The preview endpoint returns staged cloud infrastructure setup data containing IAM role ARNs and cloud access keys by setup_id. It does not check if deployment_session.organization_id == current_user.organization_id, leaking sensitive cloud provider credentials.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/wizards/cloud-deployments/stg_infra_99014/preview HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
